lines: Raat ke do baje jangal se mare hue insaan ki awaaz aayi...
Par asli khatra kamre ke bahar nahi, andar tha.
Palamau ke Mahua jangal ke kinare Meera apne chhote bhai ke saath so rahi thi.
Achanak aangan mein uski divangatai maa ki lori goonjne lagi.
Dadi ne sakht hidayat di thi— kabhi darwaza mat kholna!
Meera ne dar ke maare Aarav ko kaskar pakad liya.
Meera... darwaza khol beta... Aarav ko bacha le!
Tabhi rasoi ke andar se thak-thak ki awaaz aayi.
Meera ne laalten uthai to dekha... Dadi kaala dhaaga baandh rahi thi.
Aarav ki jaan Dadi ne tantra-mantra se is ghar ki mitti se baandh rakhi thi!
Bahar rone wali aatma use maarne nahi... Dadi ke changul se bachane aayi thi.
Raat mein jise tum bhoot samajhte ho... shayad wo tumhara apna ho.
